fact: Since the national portal Dzair Digital Services launched on 5 July 2026, birth, marriage and death certificates are requested online through the Interior Ministry section of dzds.dz, replacing the December 2020 etatcivil.interieur.gov.dz portal.
title: Acte de naissance, casier judiciaire, NIF… les papiers à obtenir en ligne sur Dzair Digital Services
